title: 出口强劲撑经济：贸易伙伴为何紧张，欧盟已备应急计划
speaker: Mary Lovely

segments.en: Decision let's talk about we're getting a data dump from China later today including GDP by most accounts
segments.zh: 决定，我们来谈谈今天晚些时候中国将发布的数据，包括GDP，根据大多数人的说法。

segments.en: Obviously the Chinese economy is still sputtering along not doing so well domestic consumption is quite weak almost historical levels
segments.zh: 显然中国经济仍在蹒跚前行，表现不太好，国内消费相当疲软，几乎处于历史水平。

segments.en: But their exports have been really propping them up 36% up in September
segments.zh: 但他们的出口一直在真正支撑他们，9月份增长了36%。

segments.en: That is really drawing the eye of many trading partners not just the United States the European Union is coming up with their own contingency plans of a trade war
segments.zh: 这确实吸引了许多贸易伙伴的目光，不仅是美国，欧盟也在制定自己的贸易战应急计划。

segments.en: Is more insulated than others because of our trade barriers
segments.zh: 由于我们的贸易壁垒，比其他国家更绝缘。

segments.en: US the share of US imports coming from China has really plummeted. It's gone back up in recent
segments.zh: 美国从中国进口的份额确实大幅下降，最近又回升了。

segments.en: Months because of the AI build out
segments.zh: 几个月，因为人工智能建设。

segments.en: The if you look at the growth in global trade
segments.zh: 如果你看全球贸易的增长。

segments.en: 42% of it is just AI related products according to the WTO
segments.zh: 根据世贸组织，其中42%只是人工智能相关产品。

segments.en: So the AI boom is really masking. I think a lot of underlying weaknesses and vulnerabilities
segments.zh: 所以人工智能热潮确实掩盖了许多潜在的弱点和脆弱性。

segments.en: Europe of course right on the front line and they're having very heated conversations within the membership
segments.zh: 欧洲当然处于前线，他们在成员国之间进行了非常激烈的对话。

segments.en: About what are they going to do about China? We saw recently, you know, that they have made an agreement with the Chinese
segments.zh: 关于他们对中国将采取什么行动？我们最近看到他们与中国达成了一项协议。

segments.en: Germany of course wants more of that France wants more of that and other industrial products
segments.zh: 德国当然想要更多，法国想要更多和其他工业产品。

segments.en: But they're also vulnerable to the critical minerals choke point. Yeah, that's right. Very lovely. I wish you talk a lot
segments.zh: 但他们也容易受到关键矿产瓶颈的影响。是的，没错。非常可爱。我希望你多谈谈。
